Controller partner0 recorded 57 failed jobs in September 2026 (UTC).

The first find_jobs call came back with total 50. That is the default max_results page, not the month: total counts only the rows returned after the cut, and nothing flags the cut. So I re-ran the same filters (controller partner0, status failed, created after 2026-09-01, created before 2026-10-01) with max_results 200 and got 57. The seven extra rows are the earliest failures of the month, 1-4 September.

Failures by template across the whole month:
- RHDP partner_ext.retail-pos-edge-lab.prod-provision: 19 failed jobs (the most)
- RHDP partner_ext.fintech-api-gateway-lab.prod-provision: 18
- RHDP partner_ext.telco-5g-core-lab.prod-provision: 12
- RHDP partner_ext.claims-ai-assist-lab.prod-provision: 8

On the first page alone, fintech-api-gateway-lab looked like the worst template (18 against 15 for retail-pos-edge-lab), because four of retail-pos-edge-lab's failures fall in the seven rows that page dropped.
